title: 琉璃万园

generationRuns.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 1024×1536 vertical tarot card master artwork for a local World holographic-card project.
Input image: the immediately previous displayed World tarot card is a reference for symbolic identity and full-body dancer composition.
Primary request: create the World tarot theme “琉璃万园 / Glasswork Myriad Garden”: exactly one full-body adult woman dancer in a soft pink-violet dress, centered on axis inside exactly one vertical oval gold-leaf ring. Her pointed foot visibly touches a shallow water platform that continues naturally to the lower edge. Place exactly one clear guardian in each safe inner corner: lion upper-left, bull upper-right, winged human lower-left, eagle lower-right. The setting is an emerald and pink-violet glass-domed garden; the curved glass dome rises behind the ring and produces gentle reflections. Keep the four guardians fixed in place and fully readable.
Style/medium: detailed painterly Art Nouveau fantasy tarot, translucent glass, white-gold accents, narrow ornate border, no title text.
Composition/framing: vertical 2:3 composition; dancer at center; dome visible behind ring; all hands, face, feet safely inside; stable four-corner arrangement.
Lighting/mood: radiant greenhouse light, emerald, pale pink violet, white gold; natural skin tone.
Constraints: exactly one dancer, exactly one oval ring, exactly one lion upper-left, bull upper-right, winged human lower-left, eagle lower-right; one continuous foot-contact water platform; no duplicate figures/rings, no overall rotation effect, no text, no watermark, no cropped anatomy.
